0022600023.text: The Warriors (2-3, 10th in the West and 2nd in the Pacific, 2 games back) host the Lakers (4-1, 1st in the Pacific, 4th in the West) in Golden State's sixth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Warriors on a two-game winning streak and the Lakers on a one-game streak. The teams' 2026-27 season series is tied at 0-1 in the Lakers' favor after the Lakers won 127-105 in Los Angeles on October 21, and the Warriors lost the 2025-26 series 1-3. For Golden State, Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery) are out, and Gui Santos (knee tendinitis) is day-to-day and a game-time decision; for Los Angeles, Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain) are out, and Ziaire Williams (foot) is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
